summary_1line: Vyasa briefly reunites Janamejaya with his dead father Parikshit; Dhritarashtra releases the Pandavas to return and rule while he and the elders pursue austere penance.

image_candidates.scene_text: Vyasa summons Parikshit from heaven, and King Janamejaya beholds his radiant father standing before him in the same royal form as in life.
The aged Dhritarashtra embraces the Pandavas one by one in the forest hermitage before sending them back to rule their kingdom.
Kunti smells the heads of her sons in farewell while Gandhari blesses them, as the royal family prepares to depart the forest retreat.
